newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S&P affirms A- long term rating on Sweden's GMB.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms A- long term rating on Sweden's GMB.

text.p: U.S. credit ratings agency Standard & Poor's said on Tuesday it had affirmed its A- long-term counterparty rating on Sweden's General Mortgage Bank (GMB), raising the bank's outlook to stable from negative.
GMB is the funding vehicle for Landshypotek AB, the largest provider of agricultural mortgages in Sweden.

"The revised outlook reflects improvements in the financial performance of Landshypotek and developments in the Swedish economy, whereby interest rates have fallen sharply over the past 12 months," S&P said in a statement.
It said lower rates had enhanced the ability of Landshypotek's borrowers to service their debt obligations.

"Landshypotek's improved financial strength will bolster the bank's capitalisation through profit retentions and somewhat offset Standard & Poor's concerns in respect of the company's ability to raise core capital," the agency said.
